items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: And Gary Bartz was in that band at that time. He was there as well.

ctx.x: What can you share with us about Sun Ra?

Sunny was very interesting man. Sunny, it was an important time for me to meet Sunny and to — I actually auditioned to play with his group. It was a brief time but it was a time, it was amazing. He’s a remarkable musician and a remarkable spirit. He has a concept that still lives today even though he’s not here so there is something really really special and important about him. Playing in that band, well let’s see, that’s where I met John Gilmore as well and a quick story, I was the newbie in the band and I’m…

That’s a great memory. And I had the pleasure of talking with Marshall Allen and he’s quite a spirit. At the end he said something like I’ve been doing this for fifty years I’m still waiting to make some money.
